# A box's parts on bubbletea: the gap between them, a flexing part's share
# of its row, nothing for what draws nothing, and an image its style's size.
#
# A row's parts were written with no space between them, so columns and
# badges ran together; a part with `flex` took only its own width, so the
# columns after it never lined up; a loop's copies that drew nothing -- the
# panels of the tabs not shown -- were each a blank line; and an image was
# its style's height in columns rather than rows, a dozen blank rows under a
# picture twice as wide as it is tall. The snapshot is the screen as text.
#
# Confirmed against the codegen before: `1   Applesfruit`, three blank lines
# above `only the third`, and the image twelve rows tall.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
# The loop's one drawn copy is the first line, a gap of one row (16px)
# between each two parts after it, and no other blank line but the image's
# second row.
grep '\Aonly the third' app.sngl.snapshots/table.ansi
grep -count=6 '(?m)^ *$' app.sngl.snapshots/table.ansi
# A part is a gap of one column (8px) from the next, and the flexing name
# takes what the row's 80 columns leave, so the kinds line up.
grep '(?m)^1    Apples {61}fruit' app.sngl.snapshots/table.ansi
grep '(?m)^12   Spring onions {54}root' app.sngl.snapshots/table.ansi
grep '(?m)^one two' app.sngl.snapshots/table.ansi
# The image is 8 columns by 2 rows, the text a gap beside it.
grep '(?m)^ {9}beside' app.sngl.snapshots/table.ansi

-- app.sngl --
import seq "sngl:seq"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

// Renders nothing, as a request does.
component asker(n int) ui.node {
    var seen = 0

    effect(on=n, @mount(k) { seen = k })
}

component line(count string, name string, kind string) ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={gap=8px}) {
        ui.text(value=count, style={width=32px})
        ui.text(value=name, style={flex=1})
        ui.text(value=kind, style={width=64px})
    }
}

component table ui.node {
    var seen = 0
    var key = 1

    ui.vbox(style={gap=16px}) {
        for var i = seq.count(3) {
            asker(n=i)
        }
        asker(n=4)
        effect(on=key, @mount(k) { seen = k })
        for var i = seq.count(4) {
            if i == 2 {
                ui.text(value="only the third")
            }
        }
        line(count="1", name="Apples", kind="fruit")
        line(count="12", name="Spring onions", kind="root")
        ui.hbox(style={gap=8px}) {
            for var t = ["one", "two"] {
                ui.text(value=t)
            }
        }
        ui.hbox(style={gap=8px}) {
            ui.image(alt="nothing", style={width=64px, height=32px}) {
                ui.file(path="missing.png")
            }
            ui.text(value="beside")
        }
        ui.text(value="after")
    }
}

func testTable(t test.Test, c table) {
    t.snapshot("table")
}

ui.window {
    table
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/table/1 --
